definition_en: A specified point or extent in a reference space.
example_sentence: 传感器的位置标在地图上。

definition_en: The region enclosed by a reference entity.
example_sentence: 电池安装在机器人躯干的内部。

definition_en: A region beyond the boundary of a reference entity
example_sentence: 摄像头固定在外壳的外部。

definition_en: A line delimiting the extent of an area.
example_sentence: 白线标出了运动区域的边界。

definition_en: A central point fixed by the limits of a reference figure.
example_sentence: 圆盘的中心有一个小孔。

definition_en: The part of an entity facing a specified observer or direction.
example_sentence: 门的前面装着一盏灯。

definition_en: A region on the left of a reference entity under a specified viewpoint
example_sentence: 传感器安装在机身左侧。

definition_en: The degree to which a surface inclines relative to horizontal.
example_sentence: 这段斜坡的坡度约为十五度。

definition_en: A region higher than a reference entity along the relevant vertical axis
example_sentence: 吊灯在桌子的上方。

definition_en: A region lower than a reference entity along the relevant vertical axis
example_sentence: 电源线从桌子的下方穿过。

definition_en: North of a mountain or south of a river under a traditional geographic convention.
example_sentence: 山的北面称为阴。

definition_en: South of a mountain or north of a river under a traditional geographic convention.
example_sentence: 山的南面称为阳。

definition_en: An intervening region bounded by two specified reference entities
example_sentence: 两座楼之间有一条小路。

definition_en: The measurable interval between two places.
example_sentence: 两个路标之间的距离是五米。

definition_en: A narrow opening between nearby surfaces or objects.
example_sentence: 木板之间留有一道空隙。

definition_en: A route along which motion could occur.
example_sentence: 机器人沿着标出的路径前进。

definition_en: To move along a route around a physical reference entity
example_sentence: 无人机环绕塔楼飞行。

definition_en: A tangent relation where surfaces meet at a point or line without crossing.
example_sentence: 圆与直线在一点接触。

definition_en: An arrangement whose parts correspond across a line, point, or plane.
example_sentence: 图案的对称关系以中线为轴。

definition_en: To bear an object's load so that it does not fall.
example_sentence: 支架托住了横梁。

definition_en: The place or region occupied by an entity in a reference space.
example_sentence: The sensor's location is marked on the map.

definition_en: A line or surface marking the limit of a region.
example_sentence: The white line marks the boundary of the test area.

definition_en: A point equally distant from specified limits of a figure.
example_sentence: A small hole lies at the center of the disk.

definition_en: A short distance between entities relative to a specified scale.
example_sentence: The proximity of the two walls leaves little room for the robot.

definition_en: The measurable separation between two locations.
example_sentence: The distance between the markers is five meters.

definition_en: An open interval or space between bounded entities.
example_sentence: A narrow gap separates the two boards.

definition_en: A relation in which entities lie immediately next to each other.
example_sentence: The adjacency of the rooms allows a shared doorway.

definition_en: The arrangement of entities along a common line or direction.
example_sentence: The alignment of the sensors follows the corridor.

definition_en: The amount of turn between intersecting lines or planes.
example_sentence: The two beams meet at a right angle.

definition_en: The spatial interval keeping two entities apart.
example_sentence: The separation between the plates is two centimeters.

definition_en: The spatial arrangement of a body and its limbs.
example_sentence: The robot changed its posture to pass through the opening.

definition_en: In a region enclosed by the boundary of a reference entity
example_sentence: The sensor is inside the box.

definition_en: At a higher position than a physical reference entity along a vertical axis
example_sentence: The lamp is above the table.

definition_en: At a lower position than a reference entity along a vertical axis
example_sentence: The cable runs below the shelf.

definition_en: On or toward the opposite side of an intervening region
example_sentence: The robot moved across the courtyard.

definition_en: Along a route entering and leaving a bounded region
example_sentence: The robot passed through the doorway.

definition_en: A route connecting positions through space.
example_sentence: The robot followed the marked path.

definition_en: A state in which two physical surfaces meet.
example_sentence: The wheel made contact with the floor.

definition_en: The ability to maintain an upright bodily position without falling.
example_sentence: The climber kept her balance on the beam.
uncertainty_note: The bodily balance sense has no verified compatible S path; leave S=NA.

definition_en: To bear a load or counter a force that would displace an entity.
example_sentence: The column supports the roof.
uncertainty_note: Motor and proprioceptive grounding may differ between an active person and a passive pillar; review the target sense and scores.
